item.description: It was 10:45 AM in Bakersfield CA, and temps had already reached 102°. Grape pickers and packers are hard at work under the hot sun. The pickers steadily fill trays with freshly harvested grapes & packers carefully inspect, organize and stack each box for shipment. #WeFeedYou
